snippet.title: Neuter Master // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3889950/Neuter_Master/

A lighthearted roguelite breeding game where you match animals on a customizable grid, earn gold with slot-machine-style combos, and balance breeding, sterilizing, and upgrades to keep your herd thriving year after year.

Developed by 
PcZ Games
